Definition
[$\lambda $-, $ ar\lambda $-, $\mu $-, and $ u $-invariants] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0397, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0398, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0399, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0401 1. appD:D.43–D.50,D.53\group Perelman Functionals

Define \[ \lambda (g)=\inf _{\int e^{-f}d\mu =1}\mathcal F(g,f),\qquad ar\lambda (g)=\lambda (g)\operatorname {Vol}(\mathcal M,g)^{2/n}, \] \[ \mu (g, au )=\inf _{\int (4\pi au )^{-n/2}e^{-f}d\mu =1} \mathcal W(g,f, au ),\qquad u (g)=\inf _{ au >0}\mu (g, au ). \] Equivalently, $\lambda (g)$ is the lowest eigenvalue of $-4\Delta +R$ and has a unique positive normalized eigenfunction. The infimum defining $\mu (g, au )$ is finite and is attained by a smooth minimizer.
